notes.title: DEMO v0.2 updates
notes.content:
DEMO v0.2.4 updates

Playability Adjustments:
1.Adjusted the appearance levels of Rare (Level 16 -> Level 11), Epic (Level 26 -> Level 21), and Legendary (Level 36 -> Level 31) skills and artifacts.
2.Reduced the gold output in the later stages.
3.Skill: Changed the rarity of Silence Curse (Rare -> Uncommon).
4.Artifact Glue modification: Every attack: Add Restore to first skill (each skill can cast 1 times per battle) -> Every attack: Add Restore to first 2 skills (each skill can cast 1 times per battle) 
5.Artifact Adhesive modification: Every attack: Add Restore to last skill (each skill can cast 1 times per battle) -> Every attack: Add Restore to last 2 skills (each skill can cast 1 times per battle) 
6.New skills added:
6.1 Silence Curse Reverse
6.2 Healing Bone
6.3 Attack Curse Ex

notes.title: Demo v0.2.3 updates
notes.content:
Demo v0.2.3

2.2 The original default difficulty is now set to Difficult.

notes.title: TOKIGEON DEMO NOW available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm tungfai, the demo of TOKIGEON is now available!

This time, I'm bringing you a deck building rogue-like game. The gameplay is more akin to a combination of card-building and auto-chess.
In this demo, it has 1 type of weapon, 6 types of skills, 100+ skills in total, as well as dozens of artifacts and spells, offering more than 10+ different build strategies.
The game currently supports Chinese and English. If you would like to see additional languages added, please let me know. I'll try my best to include them (for now, I'm only proficient in Chinese and English. For other languages, I might need to use translation tools, but I am not able to proofread them). If you're interested in helping with adding new language translations or proofreading, please contact me via email or Discord! Thank you!
If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to reach out to me through email or by joining Discord.

Email:iam@tungfaifong.com

qq group:1028412548
Discord: https://discord.gg/HCFjycJqJU


If you enjoy the game, I hope you'll consider adding it to your wishlist! Thank you so much!
